test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The historical fiction 'The Glory of Patan' by KM Munshi was originally written in which Indian language?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Gujarati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'The Glory of Patan'** is a historical fiction novel originally written in the **Gujarati** language.
 
• The book was authored by **K. M. Munshi**, a renowned writer, historian, and freedom fighter from India.
 
• K. M. Munshi is highly regarded for his extensive contributions to Gujarati literature and his role in shaping Indian cultural and historical narratives.
 
• **'The Glory of Patan'** is part of the **Patan Trilogy**, a series of historical novels set in medieval Gujarat.
 
• The novel captures the essence of Gujarat's rich cultural heritage and the valor of the Chalukya dynasty, focusing on themes like heroism, loyalty, and the complexities of statecraft.
 
• It provides a vivid portrayal of the city of Patan, which was an important cultural and political center in Gujarat during the medieval period.
 
• The book reflects K. M. Munshi's deep understanding of India's history and his ability to weave it into compelling literary works.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Malayalam**__

 __
 
• **Malayalam** is a Dravidian language spoken predominantly in the state of **Kerala** and the union territories of **Lakshadweep** and **Puducherry** (Mahe) in India.
 
• It is known for its rich literary tradition, with notable authors like **Vaikom Muhammad Basheer** and **Thakazhi Sivasankara Pillai**.
 
 
 
• **Bengali**__
 __
 
• **Bengali** is an Indo-Aryan language primarily spoken in the Indian state of **West Bengal**, **Tripura**, and in **Bangladesh**.
 
• It has a celebrated literary history, with iconic figures like **Rabindranath Tagore**, who won the **Nobel Prize in Literature**.
 
 
 
• **Tamil**__
 
 
• **Tamil** is a classical Dravidian language spoken in the Indian state of **Tamil Nadu** and in **Sri Lanka** and **Singapore**.
 
• It is one of the world's oldest languages with a rich literary tradition, including works like the **Sangam literature**.
